title: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Advances in technology have improved the way people enjoy their free time. Support your answer with specific reasons and examples.
text:
# Part 1
I strongly agree that technology has improved our free time. 
There are several reasons to support my opinion.

# Part 2
First of all, it is really helpful for most people.
For instance, I am into K-pop music and a huge fan of BTS. /In the past, whenever they released a new album, I would participate in their concert./ However, I had to get the tickets, take a bus, and commute. /It was really fun, but it took a lot of time and effort.

# Part 3
Now, because of advances in technology, I can easily watch their livestreams through AR/VR online. /This new technology allows me to see my favorite idol group in person from my living room./ I can still enjoy the atmosphere and feel the energy of the crowd without traveling. /It is a great way for me to release stress and recharge my batteries. 

# Part 4
Therefore, technology definitely makes our entertainment better.

segments.text: I strongly agree that technology has improved our free time.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.
First of all, it is really helpful for most people.
For instance, I am into K-pop music and a huge fan of BTS.
In the past, whenever they released a new album, I would participate in their concert.
However, I had to get the tickets, take a bus, and commute.
It was really fun, but it took a lot of time and effort.
Now, because of advances in technology, I can easily watch their livestreams through AR
This new technology allows me to see my favorite idol group in person from my living room.
I can still enjoy the atmosphere and feel the energy of the crowd without traveling.
It is a great way for me to release stress and recharge my batteries.
Therefore, technology definitely makes our entertainment better.
